email_subject: Application for Digital Communication & Social Media Specialist
email_body:
Dear Ilse Sant,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Communication & Social Media Specialist position at BENEO-Orafti Belgium. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content creation, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your team in Tienen.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites. I have hands-on experience with social media management, including content planning and community engagement for my own project, mirook.com. I am proficient in tools like Canva, Google Analytics, and SEMrush, and I have experience with generative AI tools like ChatGPT for content optimization.

I am particularly drawn to BENEO's mission of advancing healthier nutrition and sustainability. My analytical mindset and interest in health topics align well with your needs. I am eager to bring my skills in paid LinkedIn campaigns, content creation, and KPI reporting to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to BENEO's digital communication efforts.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

baverok@gmail.com

cover_letter:
Dear Ilse Sant,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Communication & Social Media Specialist position at BENEO-Orafti Belgium. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, content creation, and social media management, I am confident in my ability to support your global communication efforts and contribute to impactful marketing projects.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained practical experience in on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content writing, and WordPress site management. I have successfully improved organic visibility for client websites by implementing structured data and conducting technical audits. My work on mirook.com, a project I designed and built from scratch, involved creating engaging content and integrating social media channels, which sharpened my storytelling and copywriting skills in English.

I am well-versed in social media platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook, and I have experience with paid campaigns and community management. I am proficient in using tools like Canva for content creation and Google Analytics for performance tracking. Additionally, I have experience with generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, which I use to streamline content production and enhance creativity.

Your job posting emphasizes the importance of a commercial mindset and an analytical eye. My background in SEO and data-driven decision-making aligns well with this requirement. I am also genuinely interested in health and nutrition topics, which makes BENEO's mission particularly appealing to me.

I am eager to bring my skills in digital communication, content creation, and campaign management to your team in Tienen. I am available for the temporary contract from December 2026 to June 2027 and can start immediately.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to BENEO's digital future.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
